headline: Executive order creates a federal committee to oversee trade in cars and car parts under the new US-Mexico-Canada trade deal.
what_it_does: This order sets up an Interagency Committee on Trade in Automotive Goods, as called for by Section 202A of the law that put the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) into effect. Based on the title, the committee brings together several federal agencies to handle matters related to trade in automotive goods under the agreement. No summary was provided, so details about the committee's members and specific duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are organized into a new committee to work together on automotive trade issues under the USMCA.

who_it_affects.group: Automakers and auto parts companies that trade among the US, Mexico, and Canada
who_it_affects.how: The committee's work on automotive trade under the USMCA may affect how the agreement's rules for vehicles and parts are carried out.
